metadata.description: Open-source Nintendo 3DS emulator based on Citra

doc.source: The immutable upstream 2126.0 tag with its submodules. The flake writes GIT-TAG and GIT-COMMIT because the input carries no .git.
doc.platforms: The Steam Deck's x86_64-linux closure and the macOS aarch64-darwin build, the systems the flake builds (checks.platform-matrix compares them).
